thread:
sophia_ae: Heads-up: Galactica Health POC started load test. They're getting a mix of 429s and a single 503. Also asked about Dedicated POC pricing and whether logs can be PHI-redacted. Need triage + pricing note.

mike_se: Copy. Sample traffic? prompt sizes? SDK or raw HTTP?

sophia_ae: ~75 reqs/s sustained for 6m, prompts ~180 tokens, using our Node SDK with api key. First 429 at 11:07 UTC. They shared one 503 payload: {"time":"2026-06-15T11:07:22Z","status":503,"error":"service_unavailable"}.

anika_infra: Can you pass client id/tenant?

sophia_ae: client=galactica-poc, tenant=galactica-hc.

ryan_sre: Quick look: pattern matches hosted soft-burst throttle + short-lived upstream restart causing the 503. I'll check node restarts and rate limiter events.

notify-bot: Autoscaler: added 1 redwood-large pod in us-west-2 at 2026-06-15T11:09:12Z.

mike_se: @galactica, do you have client-side retries/backoff and max concurrency?

sophia_ae: They have naive retries with no jitter and 20 concurrent workers. They're willing to back off if we patch.

anika_infra: We can enable per-tenant leaky-bucket shaping and grant a 24h burst uplift to smooth this. That should eliminate 429s immediately.

liz_csm: I'll collect the security questionnaire and their legal contact. On PHI: hosted does redaction heuristics; for guaranteed PHI controls we recommend Dedicated with customer-managed KMS and retention policy.

ryan_sre: Immediate actions: (1) infra to apply 24h burst uplift, (2) advise client to reduce concurrency to 10 and add jittered backoff, (3) monitor for 2h.

anika_infra: Applying temporary burst now.

notify-bot: RateLimitUpdate: tenant=galactica-poc, extra_burst_tokens=180k, window=24h at 2026-06-15T11:12:05Z.

sophia_ae: I told them we applied a temporary burst and recommended backoff + concurrency cap to 10. They're ok to throttle and will send questionnaire by EOD. They also asked: "If we switch to Dedicated, how fast can we get a trial and what's incremental cost?"

mike_se: Dedicated trial: typical 5-8 days to provision in-region; we offer a 14-day sandbox with ~+35% uplift on compute vs hosted. Private on-prem is multi-week. I'll prepare a one-pager.

liz_csm: Action items: sophia collect security questionnaire + SOC2 contact (EOD), mike to send Dedicated trial one-pager + sample SLA (by 17:30 PT), anika/ryan monitor 24h and report if 429s/503s persist.

sophia_ae: Thanks all. I'll update Galactica and ask them to reduce concurrency.

ryan_sre: Monitoring now. Will escalate to #incidents if 503 >0.3% for 10m. :eyes:
